rationale: v1.81.0 already treats all active problem binaries as alarms and hides diagnostic siblings from the ordinary info rows. This repairs that existing service/alarm confusion and makes current alarm causes visible; it is not limited to an intermediate beta regression.

summary.ru: Причины тревог видны в карточке устройства; напоминания об обслуживании Home Connect больше не вызывают красную пульсацию.
summary.en: Device cards explain alarm causes; Home Connect service reminders no longer trigger red alarm pulsing.
